title: K8s Stack Manager
description: Backend metrics of K8s Stack Manager from the Prometheus /metrics endpoint (METRICS_ENABLED / metrics.enabled, scraped per pod): API, auth, deployments, hooks, clusters, WebSocket fan-out, database pool and Go runtime.

panels.title: Active instances
panels.description: Instances that are deploying or running.

panels.title: Leader replicas
panels.description: Replicas that run the background workers. Expected: exactly 1.

panels.title: Active operations
panels.description: Deploy, stop, clean and rollback operations that run now.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx (5m)
panels.description: Server errors in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Rate limited (5m)
panels.description: 429 responses of the API rate limiter in the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", http_route!~"/health.*"}[$__range]))) >= 0)

panels.title: Active operations and interrupt events
panels.description: Interrupt events: recovered (the leader ended an operation of a stopped replica), late_finalize_skipped, queued_cancelled.

panels.title: Hook dispatches by event and outcome
Cluster status changes and pull secret refresh
Leader per replica
panels.description: 1 on the replica that runs the background workers (TTL reaper, cleanup scheduler, status watcher, recovery).

panels.title: DB pool waits
panels.description: A request waits when all connections are in use (DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS).

panels.title: Open stream sessions by kind
panels.description: Open port-forward and exec sessions (stack_stream.sessions_active), per kind, summed over the replicas.

panels.title: Stream bytes by kind and direction
Closed sessions by kind and reason
panels.description: Sessions that ended (stack_stream.sessions_closed_total), by close reason.

panels.title: Rejected stream requests by kind and reason
panels.description: Requests refused before the upgrade (stack_stream.rejected_total), for example feature disabled, forbidden or tunnel limit.

panels.title: Exec commands by result
panels.description: Finished exec commands (stack_stream.exec_exit_total), by result: zero and nonzero exit code, error (stream error) and timeout (max duration).
